mechanicalLevels.description: 3-level feed dog height adjustment lever for material thickness

panel.type: Blue box with LED digital tube display, 2-button only
buttons: ▼ (down) — speed decrease / value adjust / factory reset (long press)
panel.display: LED digital tube — shows speed, error codes, parameter values (e.g. 'F8' for F interface, 'T' for durability mode)

operations.speedAdjust: Short press ▲ to increase speed by 100rpm. Short press ▼ to decrease by 100rpm. Speed auto-saves approximately 3 seconds after last press.
operations.needlePosition: Long press ▲ for 3s in standby to toggle needle stop position up/down (auto-saved).
operations.factoryReset: Long press ▼ for 3s in standby. Display shows '88' or 'EE' during reset.
operations.parameterEntry: Press ▲ and ▼ simultaneously for 3s → F interface (display shows 'F8').

parameterEntry.fInterface: Hold ▲+▼ simultaneously for 3s → F interface. Short press ▲ to cycle through parameters (K→L→M→H→V→J→r→Y→w). Short press ▼ to enter value view. Short press ▼ again to adjust value. Short press ▲ to save (displays 'ok'). Returns to F interface. Motor automatically returns to standby.
parameterEntry.durabilityMode: In F interface, long press ▲ for 3s → display shows 'T' (durability mode). Short press ▲ to set durability parameters (run time, stop time). Short press ▼ to start durability test. Short press ▲ during test to return to standby.

parameters.name: Maximum Speed
parameters.description: Maximum speed in units of 100rpm (05=500rpm, 50=5000rpm, 55=5500rpm). Adjusts in 500rpm increments per step.

parameters.name: Needle Position Switch
parameters.description: 0=needle stop disabled, 1=needle stop enabled. If positioner damaged, set to 0 to suppress E5.

parameters.name: Sleep Time
parameters.description: Auto sleep time. Unit: 10 minutes (e.g. 3=30min). Set 0 to disable sleep function.

parameters.name: Speed Display
parameters.description: 0=speed not shown on display during standby, 1=speed shown

parameters.name: Serial Number Query
parameters.description: Displays the 9 serial numbers from the machine label. Read-only.

parameters.name: Durable Mode Running Time
parameters.description: Run time per cycle in durability test mode. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Durable Mode Stop Time
parameters.description: Stop time per cycle in durability test mode. Unit: seconds.

troubleshooting.cause: Machine head stuck, material too thick for torque, motor plug loose, circuit board fault
troubleshooting.solution: Check head clearance and material thickness. Verify motor plug is fully seated. Use 3-level adjustment lever (A/M/H) to match material. Replace controller if all checks pass.
Restart first. If persisting, do factory reset (long press ▼ 3s). If still failing after reset, replace circuit board DSP chip.

troubleshooting.cause: Encoder cable damaged, connector withdrawn/deformed, Hall sensor broken, motor coil burnt
troubleshooting.solution: Inspect all encoder wiring and connectors for damage. Check motor physically. May require motor or controller replacement.

troubleshooting.cause: Position encoder disconnected, plug loose, or positioner damaged
troubleshooting.solution: Check and reseat positioner plug. If needle stop function is not required, long press ▲ for 3s after E5 to disable it (equivalent to setting parameter M=0).

troubleshooting.issue: E6 — Governor abnormal (false trigger when pressing pedal)
troubleshooting.cause: Governor connector not fully plugged in
troubleshooting.solution: Short press ▲ to clear false E6. Check governor plug for full seating. Inspect pin contacts.

troubleshooting.issue: Ea / Eb / Ec — Power supply faults
troubleshooting.cause: Input voltage out of normal range or power supply board failure
troubleshooting.solution: Check input voltage. Normal operating range is approximately 154-264V based on alarm thresholds (r/Y parameters). Inspect power supply board.

troubleshooting.cause: F interface parameter L is set below maximum
troubleshooting.solution: Enter F interface (▲+▼ held 3s), navigate to L parameter. Default is 50 (5000rpm). Increase to 55 for 5500rpm maximum.

troubleshooting.issue: Needle not stopping at correct position
troubleshooting.cause: Needle position switch M=0 in F interface, or positioner fault (E5)
troubleshooting.solution: Enter F interface, set M=1 to enable needle stop. If E5 is showing, check positioner connection first.

troubleshooting.cause: Sleep time H parameter set too short
troubleshooting.solution: Enter F interface, increase H parameter (default 3=30min, max 6=60min). Set H=0 to disable sleep entirely.

troubleshooting.issue: Fabric wrinkling or stretching during sewing
troubleshooting.cause: Differential ratio not adjusted for material
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust differential ratio mechanically (0.7-2.0 range). For wrinkle: increase differential (surplus setting). For stretch: decrease differential (deficit setting).

troubleshooting.cause: 3-level feed dog lever not set for heavy material
troubleshooting.solution: Move adjustment lever to H position for thick/multi-layer material (up to 8-12 layers denim).

needleBarHeight.4thread: Left needle to needle plate = 10.5mm when needle bar at highest point. Adjust via needle bar adjust screw.
needleBarHeight.5thread: Left needle to needle plate = 11.5mm when needle bar at highest point.

lowerLooper.gap: When needle bar at lowest: distance from lower looper tip to center of left needle = 3-3.5mm
lowerLooper.clearance: Clearance between looper needle and sewing needle = 0.03-0.05mm

upperLooper.4thread: At highest position: tip to left needle center = 5.4-5.7mm; height to throat plate = 11.5mm
upperLooper.5thread: At highest position: tip to left needle center = 4.5-5.0mm; height to throat plate = 10.5mm
upperLooper.3thread: Height from upper looper to throat plate = 10.5mm

lookerIntersection.description: When upper and lower loopers move to their intersection point

mechanicalAdjustments.rearGuardNeedle: When lower looper moves left-to-right to hook position, rear guard needle should be in contact with sewing needle.
mechanicalAdjustments.frontNeedleGuard: When rear guard is in contact with needle, gap between front guard and needle = 0.2-0.5mm
mechanicalAdjustments.feedToothHeight: 0.8-1mm above needle plate surface when feed tooth at highest point

cuttingKnife.lowerKnife: Should be flat (flush) with needle plate surface
cuttingKnife.biteAmount: Upper and lower knife overlap bite = 0.5-1mm

mechanicalAdjustments.wireRodClearance: When needle bar at lowest point: clearance between wire rod and housing = 7mm. Front needle guard must not touch wire rod.
mechanicalAdjustments.stitchLengthAdjustment: Press stitch length button and turn handwheel. Button at deepest position = maximum forward stitch length.
mechanicalAdjustments.differentialAdjustment: Turn differential wrench. Surplus (upward) = fabric stretch. Deficit (downward) = fabric contraction. Tighten fastening screws after adjustment.
